recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit as-is. Any future work on validator runtime options should be handled in current validator/tooling documentation rather than by duplicating already-present validation misuse guidance in core.
issue_request: FHIR-12961 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core change request for the validation page to warn against improper production/runtime use of validation, including performance and data-quality harms, security validation needs, appropriate runtime validation choices, and secondary-use impacts.
initial_application: The request was applied in SVN revision 13269, preserved in git as 26c933c82f1c19283a7d2e1642aa3a2abe112085, whose subject explicitly includes GF#12961 and which added the Correct Use of Validation section to source/validation.html plus a security-page narrative-validation clarification.
additional_context: The current validation and security pages are active documentation pages linked from source/documentation.html. The validation page still warns about production validation costs, data loss, historical-data failures, security validation, control-point validation, Postel's law, and careful runtime error handling. The security page includes Input Validation guidance and narrative-security validation guidance. Later Published issue FHIR-31735 intentionally moved validator-specific tooling documentation out of validation.html to Confluence/tooling pages, explaining why the older validator-jar runtime-options sentence is not still present in core source.
reconciliation: No source change was made because the current source already satisfies the final WG request. Adding more local prose would duplicate existing guidance and increase maintenance drift without changing implementer understanding.
